title: Treatment reminders not always working
symptom: Treatment reminders for split insulin doses do not fire as expected: when splitting a dose (half at 6pm and half at 7pm), no reminder to inject the second half is received. Also, a user reports that a reminder to eat after a pre-bolus is delayed until the phone is unlocked and xDrip is opened.
evidence_quote: If I'm splitting my dose, say half at 6pm and half at 7pm, I get no reminder to inject.
